description:
Put one or more media files into your workspace media library (max 10, uploaded sequentially). This is step one of attaching media to a node - follow up with clipform_attach_node_media to place the returned media_asset_id on a node.

When a public URL is provided, the media is fetched and stored automatically. For video: ingested via Mux. For image: stored in Supabase. Word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts enable per-word highlighting in the viewer once attached - pass the caption_ref it returned instead of hand-copying the captions array.

Provide media via `items` (explicit type + URL), `files` (files attached by the host client), or both. At least one is required.

files.description: Files attached by the host client. Each becomes a video or still library asset based on its declared mime_type.

download_url.description: Short-lived URL the server downloads the file's bytes from

file_id.description: Host-assigned identifier for the attached file

mime_type.description: Declared MIME type - determines whether the file becomes a video or still asset

items.description: One or more media items to create as workspace library assets

ai_generated.description: Whether this media was AI-generated. Drives the viewer's disclosure chip - set true for AI-rendered/synthesized media.

caption_ref.description: caption_ref from clipform_generate_tts - an opaque handle that attaches that TTS run's word-level captions to this asset, resolved server-side. Preferred over captions.

captions.description: Word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts. `words` is a required field on each caption (schema-enforced) - pass the full objects returned by clipform_generate_tts unmodified.

words.description: Per-word timestamps within the segment. Required - copy the full array from clipform_generate_tts verbatim.

url.description: Public URL that links directly to the media file itself. When provided, the server fetches and stores it directly.

name: clipform_upload_media_asset

results.description: One result per item, in order

stored.description: Bytes already stored (URL-based); false when an upload_url is pending

title: Upload Media Asset
